name: Weaponmaster
tooltip:
Weaponmaster
Talent
Requires Warrior
Requires level 1
Requires Weapons
Gives your melee weapon attacks a benefit depending on the weapon.

   Axe/Polearm: Increases your
   critical strike chance by 5%.

   Mace/Staff: Your attacks ignore
   15% of your target's armor.

   Sword: Your successful melee
   attacks have a 5% chance to
   trigger an extra attack on the
   target.
